whatsNew.title: What's new
whatsNew.subtitle: The latest changes to the developer playground.

v3.title: Address reports, battery advice and live grid power
items: Reports now has an Individual section with reports for a single address, next to the group-wide reports.

Energy benchmark report: compare an address against a random sample of other group addresses on overall usage, peak usage, standby usage and self-consumption, with percentile ranks and distribution charts.
Battery advice report: simulate a home battery against the address's real consumption and production, using EPEX spot prices or fixed rates.
Try any battery capacity and inverter power interactively and instantly see savings, investment, payback and ROI; every capacity from 1 to 30 kWh is compared in a sweep chart.
Verify the simulation with a daily charge/discharge chart and an hour-by-hour day detail, including state of charge and spot prices.
Export the battery advice as a Chargee-branded PDF (Dutch or English) with a summary, key figures, comparison table and charge/discharge appendices.
Sparky telemetry: new realtime Net power widget showing live grid consumption or return with a smooth trend sparkline.
Devices: the Sparky tab now displays the box code correctly.

v2.title: Reports and device health
items: New Reports section: generate group-wide reports for solar inverters, vehicles, chargers, HVAC, batteries and smart meters.
Reports throttle their requests across all addresses, with live progress and a cancel option.
Each report includes key metrics (device counts, address coverage, connection and health breakdowns) and a one-click CSV export.
Reports are cached per group, so you can navigate away and come back without regenerating.
Devices: solar inverters now show production health (connected, stale or disconnected) plus a Live or Cloud connection badge.
Login: 'Remember me' now keeps you signed in across reloads by refreshing your session automatically.

v1.title: Renewed playground interface
items: Rebuilt UI with a fully-typed API client generated from the live Ampere OpenAPI spec.
Group → address → device navigation with full-group address search and quick switching.
Device explorer with per-type tabs, a detail drawer, and a live indicator for steerable assets.
Telemetry for sparky, solar, smart meter, charger and address P4 energy — with charts, forecasts, zoom and local-time display.
A Raw + Docs API Inspector on every screen and a full API Console to try any endpoint.
English and Dutch throughout.
